verdict.rationale: Expensify's own blog documents an 'Ask Expensify AI Anything' assistant that lets users create, categorize, approve/reject expenses and configure workspaces via plain language, directly matching the delegation story. However, this is only first-party marketing copy with no independent or hands-on verification of the AI assistant's actual reliability; the community evidence available concerns SmartScan/mturk receipt processing, not the AI assistant itself, so it neither confirms nor disputes the feature. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of the AI assistant's task-delegation accuracy, and technical documentation (vs. blog post) describing its scope/limits.
